Level: "Bachelor" = degree listed in an undergraduate section (integrated master's such as MEng, MSci, MChem, MPhys, MPharm, MNurs, Master of Pharmacy/Optometry and medicine MBBS/MD are therefore recorded as Bachelor); "Master" = degree listed under Pre-Master's / postgraduate sections. WebFetch returns an AI summary of each page, so wording is summarised/abbreviated in places (e.g. "60% avg UFP" expanded to "60% average in UFP modules"); verify against the live pages before relying on single values.

"via": set only where the page states a route. Aston, Hull, LSBU, Sunderland, Royal Holloway, Westminster, Brunel, Lancashire mark International Year One (IY1, progression to Year 2, with * on page) on specific degrees; Pre-Master's/Master's Access routes are stated for postgraduate lists; most other undergraduate degrees have via null because the page does not map the degree to a named programme. Loughborough "Undergraduate Foundation Programme (UFP)" and "Pre-Master's Programme (PMP)" expansions are inferred from the abbreviations "UFP modules"/"PMP modules" and site navigation. Sheffield and Bath pages state UFP progression generally. UK North UG foundation route named only as Medicine Undergraduate Foundation Programme for RCSI/Nicosia; St George's Grenada route is inferred by the page summary.
